---
title: "Digital Electronics and Microcontrollers 2016-2"
---

This course introduces the fundamentals of digital electronics and microcontroller-based systems, including combinational and sequential logic, memory devices, embedded programming, timers, serial communication, analog-to-digital conversion, CCP modules, and project-based development.
